# Intentional deviations from upstream guides/optimized-baseline — one
# Python regex per line, matched against the normalized upstream line.
# Every waiver must still match something upstream (stale waivers fail the
# check). Keep the reason on the same line after the regex.

^export branch="main"                          # renamed to BRANCH (env-var naming convention)
^git clone .*\$\{branch\}                      # same clone, via ${BRANCH}
^export GUIDE_NAME="optimized-baseline"$       # same export, unquoted in the port
^export HF_TOKEN=<your HuggingFace token>$     # placeholder spelled HF_TOKEN_PLACEHOLDER
^-f \$\{REPO_ROOT\}/guides/                    # helm -f args carried via ROUTER_BASE_VALUES / ROUTER_VALUES
^export PROVIDER_NAME=gke                      # became the gateway_provider DIMENSION (rules-gated)
^--set provider\.name=\$\{PROVIDER_NAME\}      # substituted from the gateway_provider dimension
^export ACCELERATOR_TYPE=gpu                   # became the accelerator dimension
^export MODEL_SERVER=vllm                      # became the model_server dimension
^export INFRA_PROVIDER=base                    # became the infra_provider dimension
^kubectl (apply|delete) -n \$\{NAMESPACE\} -k \$\{REPO_ROOT\}/guides/\$\{GUIDE_NAME\}/modelserver/  # via the KUSTOMIZE_DIR selection steps
^curl -sSL https://raw\.githubusercontent\.com/llm-d/llm-d-benchmark/main/install\.sh  # ref pinned via ${BENCHMARK_REF}
^export ENDPOINT_URL="http://\$\(kubectl       # split into get-router-ip step + ENDPOINT_URL step
^export GATEWAY_CLASS=epponly                  # same value, quoted in the port
^export GATEWAY_CLASS=istio                    # substituted from the gateway_provider dimension
^--spec guides/optimized-baseline              # via --spec guides/${GUIDE_NAME}
^--model "Qwen/Qwen3-32B"                      # via --model "${MODEL}"
^--harness inference-perf                      # via ${HARNESS} (set in the environment section)
^--workload guide_optimized-baseline_1\.yaml   # via ${WORKLOAD} (set in the environment section)
^standalone mode$                              # heading became bold text inside get-router-ip.md
^\(optional\) enable monitoring$               # heading became 'Enable monitoring for model servers' (monitoring=on)
^send test requests$                           # reworded to 'Send a Test Request' (single asserted request)
^run the benchmark profile for optimized baseline$  # fragment is shared across guides; guide name dropped from heading
